Rory Chen: Quick heads-up 1 4: People Ops approved a targeted hiring surge for Platform & Runtime: 10 new reqs (7 new roles + 3 guaranteed backfills), plus a 6-person internal rotation pilot to redistribute critical skills. Posting starts tomorrow.

Rory Chen: Goals: reduce latency debt on runtime, accelerate Dedicated workstream, and fill gaps from recent departures. Internal transfers prioritized for the first 8 business days.

Ana Martinez: Thanks 0. Can managers opt to keep someone on their team even if theyre a rotation candidate?

Rory Chen: Managers can veto rotations with clear staffing reasons. Vetoes must include mitigation plan.

Samir Patel: Recruiters will publish REQ numbers as they go (starting REQ-4040). Internal priority window is 8 business days, then we open externally. Please encourage referrals.

Leah Park: Any special leveling for these hires? worried about senior IC gaps.

Claire Wu: No auto-level bumps. If you need an exception for a critical hire, submit a comp exception with market comps. Well fast-track approvals for up to 2 cases tied to product SLAs.

Evan Carter: Platform will run a 2-week immersion for transfers + assign a mentor. Need names by Aug 26 so we can prepare runbooks.

Meera Singh: SRE can support 2 rotation mentors for incident handoffs. Were also happy to run a triage workshop for rotated engineers.

Rory Chen: Action items: managers with approved headcount, update the centralized HR sheet (https://r.infra/hire-q4) by EOD Fri. Add "rotation-eligible" flag where relevant.

Samir Patel: Recruiter Bot: New posting REQ-4040 (Runtime Engineer) created by Samir Patel  https://recruiter.rw/REQ-4040

Samir Patel: Interview clustering request: please block 2-hour windows where possible to reduce context switching for candidates and interviewers.

Ana Martinez: Will there be a central FAQ? were getting questions from ICs.

Rory Chen: Yes  FAQ + rotation playbook + compensation guidance will be uploaded to the HR sheet and pinned in #people-ops by tomorrow noon.

Leah Park: How long are the rotations? and can they convert early?

Rory Chen: Pilot rotations are 6 weeks, with conversion option at week 4. If conversion occurs early, were committing to either backfill or re-balance other rotations within 2 weeks.

Claire Wu: Recording note for audit: please include final lists of moves and any comp exceptions by Sep 10.

Evan Carter: Also, if anyone will be on-call during the rotation, call schedule owners now so we can ensure coverage.

Meera Singh: Will prepare a short on-call checklist for rotated folks.

Rory Chen: One more: hiring managers, highlight high-priority internal candidates in column "internal_priority" on the sheet. Samir: wel try to schedule internal screens first.

Samir Patel: Reminder: internal candidates have non-binding priority. If multiple internal candidates, hiring manager decision kicks the process.

Rory Chen: Thanks all. This is a tight timeline but should help unblock several initiatives. Ping me or DM Ana/Samir for edge cases. :rocket:

Recruiter Bot: Reminder  Interview calibration session scheduled Thu 11:00am.

Leah Park: :thumbsup: Il update my team and add candidates to the sheet later today.
